description: This source file defines a visitor class for traversing the public TensorFlow API. Its purpose is to restrict traversal to only the publicly accessible parts of the API, filtering out private and internal modules or symbols.

classes.name: PublicAPIVisitor
classes.description: A visitor class designed to traverse only the public TensorFlow API, filtering out private modules and symbols based on predefined rules.

methods.name: __init__(self, visitor)
methods.description: Initializes the visitor with a user-provided visitor callable and sets up internal mappings to exclude private and certain internal modules.

methods.name: private_map(self)
methods.description: Property that returns a mapping of parent modules to internal symbols that should not be included in traversal.

methods.name: do_not_descend_map(self)
methods.description: Property that returns a mapping of parent modules to symbols that should be explored but not descended into.

methods.name: set_root_name(self, root_name)
methods.description: Overrides the default root name ('tf') for traversal.

methods.name: _is_private(self, path, name, obj=None)
methods.description: Determines whether a given symbol is considered private and should be excluded from traversal.

methods.name: _do_not_descend(self, path, name)
methods.description: Checks if a symbol should not be descended into based on internal mappings.

methods.name: __call__(self, path, parent, children)
methods.description: Implements the visitor interface that filters out private/internal symbols and controls traversal based on privacy and descend rules.
